summary: On one-column game layouts (tablet widths) the stage is capped at the board measure and pinned to the start edge, so a board narrower than the column leaves an empty strip on one side while the rail below spans the full column. GameLayout and GameSessionLayout now take an opt-in stageAlign: 'center' (puzzle frames: frame.stageAlign) that centres the stage on one column; the default stays at the start edge.
